title: Sprained ankle or wrist
scenario: Twisted ankle or wrist. Pain, swelling, bruising, hard to move the joint after a fall or misstep on debris.
steps: Rest: stop using the injured joint.
Ice: apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth for up to 20 minutes at a time, with breaks.
Compression: wrap with an elastic bandage, snug but not so tight that it tingles or turns pale.
Elevation: raise the limb above heart level when sitting or lying.
Seek medical care if you cannot bear weight, the joint looks deformed, or pain and swelling do not improve — it could be a fracture.
do_not: Do not apply a cold pack directly to bare skin.
Do not keep walking on a joint that cannot take weight.
